emulator.name: dosbox-automation
emulator.config: bridge default (machine VGA, MPU-401 present, default cycles)

captureTool: scripts/dosbox/capture-race.mjs (git revision of that file at capture time is the revision that wrote this manifest)
recipe: copy game/ to .local/dosrun (scratch copy, never the originals)

inputs.timer: not replayed (the race reads no time)
inputs.environment: stale9542 per checkpoint when present (interrupt-dependent stack word, docs/re/environment.md)

injections: sound device descriptors set to PC speaker (sound state excluded, never read by gameplay)
047c frame BP and stack pointer from the checkpoint registers
